name: Scale Economies
blurb: Per-unit cost falls as you grow; rivals can't match your cost without your share.

name: Network Economies
blurb: Each user makes the product more valuable to other users.

name: Counter-Positioning
blurb: A new model incumbents won't copy because it would damage their business.

name: Switching Costs
blurb: Customers would lose value moving to a rival for the next purchase.

name: Branding
blurb: Customers pay more for an identical offering because of who you are.

name: Cornered Resource
blurb: Preferential access to a coveted asset — patent, person, deal, deposit.

name: Process Power
blurb: Routines that deliver lower cost or better product, copyable only over years.
